ownership.developed_by: Office of the Minister of State for Administrative Reform

summary.en: DAWLATI is Lebanon's official platform for government services, providing citizens and businesses with a unified starting point to find government services, understand requirements, access government information, and use available digital services.
summary.ar: «دولتي» هي المنصة الرسمية للخدمات الحكومية في لبنان، وتوفّر للأفراد والشركات نقطة موحّدة للبحث عن الخدمات الحكومية وفهم متطلباتها والوصول إلى المعلومات والخدمات الرقمية المتاحة.

mission.en: Create one trusted platform for government services that makes it easier to find what users need, understand what is required, and know where to go.

vision.en: A Lebanon where government services are digital, accessible, and built around the people and businesses they serve.

core_functions.description_en: Helps users discover government services and identify the relevant public entity and available service information.
Provides users with a unified starting point for government service information, requirements, procedures, locations, and related guidance when available.
Provides access to official Lebanese ministry and public-institution websites.
Some supported government services can be applied for digitally through DAWLATI.
Digital payment may be available for supported services where payment integration is enabled.
Users may track requests for supported services where request tracking is enabled.

digitization_status.description_en: Government-service digitization through DAWLATI is ongoing and incremental. Not every government service is fully digital.

important: Platform-wide capabilities must not automatically be attributed to every individual service.
A service must not be described as digitally applicable unless approved service-level evidence confirms digital application.
A service must not be described as supporting online payment unless approved service-level evidence confirms online payment.
A service must not be described as supporting request tracking unless approved service-level evidence confirms request tracking.
A service being listed in the government-services directory does not automatically mean the full transaction is digital.
Do not invent service names, requirements, fees, documents, processing times, eligibility conditions, URLs, or digital capabilities.
